spanish: y vino a la libación, cuarto del hin, harás sobre el holocausto o al sacrificio, al cordero el uno.

findings.issue: «del» is unmarked grammatical smoothing that joins the absolute ordinal to the measure; it adds no referent.

notes: Wine, libation, fourth, hin, 2ms qal make, upon the burnt offering, or, for the sacrifice, for the one lamb are all licensed.
